description: Embedded desensitized sample snapshot for the smart-question-recommender-v3 skill. Safe to share with other teachers for testing.

files.tags/all_question_tags.json: Full tagged question bank, including question stems and tags.
files.tags/question_tags.jsonl: Compact tag records for each question.
files.exam/midterm_tagging_input.json: Midterm questions with score_rate, avg_score, and full_score.
files.student/student_exam_records.jsonl: Raw student answer and score records (desensitized).
files.student/student_exam_records.json: Same student records as a JSON array (desensitized).
files.student/student_mastery.jsonl: Derived mastery records by student and primary knowledge tag (desensitized).
files.index/knowledge_index.json: Question ids grouped by knowledge tag.
files.index/ability_index.json: Question ids grouped by ability tag.
files.review/all_tag_review.csv: Teacher review sheet for generated tags.

reliability_note: Only midterm questions have real score_rate. Other question difficulties are model_estimated until students answer them.
desensitization_note: Student names/ids/ticket numbers/classes have been replaced with placeholders (Student01/StudentID01/TicketID01/Class01). Scores and answer patterns are preserved for realistic recommendation testing.
